answer: The terrace is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the umber. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the violet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
